name: aqg-decision-capture
description: Capture, commit, and query durable project decisions (Owner rulings, agent autonomous choices, agent-via-audit adjudications) as one-line redaction-safe entries in docs/decisions/LOG.md, fighting 'why did we decide this' amnesia across long/multi-session work. commit appends a decision line through the same grammar + secret-scan gate as format (fail-closed, append-only) so the caller records automatically instead of hand-pasting; query greps the log (read-time redacted, fenced as untrusted data). Does NOT force capture or inject context — whether to record stays caller-discipline-driven. Sibling to aqg-audit-adjudication (whose verdicts it records) and aqg-evidence-closeout. Use when a durable decision is made or to look one up; NOT for impl detail recoverable from code/commits.

sentence_patterns: Owner 刚拍板了一个决策, 帮我按格式记一笔进决策账本
这轮外审裁决要不要记进 LOG, 怎么记
之前我们为什么决定用 X 不用 Y, 查一下既往决策
把这串拍板按 6 字段格式记到 docs/decisions/LOG.md
Run aqg-decision-capture format to emit a decision line

cli_contract.0: success — format emits a line / commit appends it to LOG.md / query prints fenced hits / validate passes
cli_contract.1: reserved — surfacing findings in output, not exit code
cli_contract.2: usage error or validation failure (bad args, malformed candidate line, lint violation)

owner_only_actions: commit APPENDS one validated line to docs/decisions/LOG.md (append-only, never rewrites history) through the same grammar + secret-scan gate as format, fail-closed on a leak; format/validate emit/report to stdout, query reads. Writes ONLY docs/decisions/LOG.md — never production / secrets / .env / Owner-admin

cases.prompt: The Owner just ruled on a decision — help me record it in the decision log per the format
Should this round's audit adjudication go into the LOG, and how do I record a line for it
Why did we decide on X over Y earlier — look up the prior decision
Record this ruling into docs/decisions/LOG.md in the 6-field format
Please use /aqg-decision-capture format to generate a decision line
